title: COMPUTATIONAL METHODS FOR ENGINEERING
description: Introduces computational methods to solve engineering problems. Translates fundamental mathematical and engineering concepts into data structures and algorithms; extends and solidifies fundamental computational skills for effective and efficient practice. Develops skills for effective visualization of data.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (ENGR 103 or 103H) and (MTH 254 or 254H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 103, ENGR 103H, MTH 254 and MTH 254H.
meeting_html: F 12pm-1:50pm in DEAR 115 - Dearborn Hall 115 (9/23 to 12/4)
